summary: Proposes a non-standard protocol for reliable communication, usable at the second or third level. It considers errors from garbled, lost or misdelivered messages, and discusses ways to improve throughput. The author does not aim to propose a new standard.

eli5.summary: When mail can get lost or smudged, a way to check each letter arrived and read well. This idea makes the connection sturdier.

questions: how to achieve reliable communication on the arpanet
how did early protocols handle message errors
